ns2:course.label: Contact Improvisation
ns2:course.description: Introduction to basic elements of Contact Improvisation through learning skills such as weight sharing, falling, rolling, responding to touch, momentum, gravity and disorientations. Course work will include dancing, dance making, viewing dance, in-class discussions and short writing assignments. Students must attend the Department of Dance's "November Dance" production in KCPA. May be repeated to a maximum of 8 hours. Prerequisite: For non-dance majors.
